title: Assistant Manger
description:
**About Tenneco**
**Job Description – Assistant Manager (Finance Department)**
 At Tenneco, we don’t follow industry standards; we set them, and we don’t settle for being best\-in\-class because we hustle to be better than best\-in\-class. Whether it’s our Core Values–radical candor, simplify, organizational velocity, tenacious execution and win–or our Get Stuff Done (GSD) mindset, we’re determined to become the most trusted partner and best manufacturer and distributor to the transportation industry.
   

  

 How do we make it happen? Through the Tenneco Way. Fueled by our Core Values, a winning mindset and a relentless commitment to excellence, the Tenneco Way is how we win. It’s what keeps Team Tenneco bold, driven, and unapologetically focused on pushing past limits and redefining success.
   

  

 Here, you’ll work alongside a team of relentless problem\-solvers who are committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results, and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are? Check out our website to discover the Tenneco Way .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and driven finance professional to support financial reporting, compliance, and operational finance activities. This role will be responsible for assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with Ind AS, while supporting quarterly reviews and annual statutory audits. The position ensures adherence to internal controls, SOX requirements, and company policies, and actively contributes to internal and external audit processes. The role involves identifying financial and operational risks and recommending control improvements to strengthen governance. Key responsibilities include fixed asset accounting, maintenance of the fixed asset register, capex tracking, CWIP review and capitalization, and asset tagging and verification. Additionally, the role oversees accounts payable activities, including past due reviews, IR/GR closure, and strengthening vendor payment and reconciliation processes. The position also provides critical financial and MIS support to plant operations, ensuring timely and accurate reporting to aid decision\-making and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Financial Reporting and Analysis: Assist in Preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial statement (Ind As).
* Assist in quarterly audit and annual statutory audit.
* Internal Control \& compliance: Ensure compliance with company policy, SOX and Internal control, Assist in Internal and External Audits.
* Identify risk and recommend control Improvement.
* FA accounting: Maintenance of Fixed Asset register, Capex tracking against approvals.
* CWIP review and capitalization, Assets Tagging and Verification.
* Account payable management: Supervise Account payable activity.
* AP past due review \& closure: IR/GR review \& closure.
* Strengthen vendor payment and reconciliation.
* Operation Support: Support to plant operation team in providing timely plant MIS


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field required
* CA\- Inter, MBA or CFA preferred
* 2\+ years of relevant experience in Finance in a Manufacturing environment.
* Team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with senior executives, peers, junior members and external partners
* Adept at identifying priorities, taking initiative and ownership
* Highly organized, hands\-on and detail oriented
* Ability to recognize improvement opportunities and execute
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint


**We don’t want average. We want exceptional. We want someone who’s hungry to build, unafraid to challenge, and bold enough to lead with empathy, speed, and precision. Sound like you? Let us know.**

title: Assistant Manager- Finance
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Business Case \& Financial Evaluation
   

  

* Prepare financial business cases for new business opportunities and ICY projects.
* Develop comprehensive business case analyses for TGM approval, including profitability, investment requirements, and risk assessment.
* Review actual business performance against TGM\-approved business cases and identify variances.
* Provide recommendations to improve profitability and business performance.


 Costing \& Product Profitability Analysis
   

  

* Review and validate Bills of Material (BOM), activity\-based costs, and manufacturing cost assumptions.
* Perform cost roll\-up activities in SAP and ensure costing accuracy within the system.
* Support product costing for new products, engineering changes, and customer quotations.
* Conduct product\-wise and customer\-wise margin analysis to support commercial decisions.
* Monitor profitability trends and identify opportunities for cost optimization.


 Pricing \& Commercial Analysis
   

  

* Review transfer pricing (TP) structures and ensure compliance with company policies.
* Evaluate purchase price variances (PPV) and analyze the impact on product profitability.
* Assess material cost fluctuations and support pricing decisions accordingly.
* Analyze manufacturing wastage, scrap costs, and yield performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Work closely with Purchasing and Operations teams to drive cost reduction initiatives.


 Financial Reporting \& Controls
   

  

* Prepare periodic profitability, costing, and variance analysis reports.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities related to product costs.
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy in costing and financial systems.
* Support internal and external audit requirements related to costing and inventory valuation.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Finance teams on commercial evaluations.
* Provide financial insights for business decisions, customer negotiations, and operational improvements.
* Support management with ad\-hoc financial analysis and strategic projects.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field required
* CA\- Inter, MBA or CFA preferred
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in Finance in a Manufacturing environment.
* Team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with senior executives, peers, junior members and external partners
* Adept at identifying priorities, taking initiative and ownership
* Highly organized, hands\-on and detail oriented
* Ability to recognize improvement opportunities and execute
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
